g.text: Both panels are HYPOTHETICAL scenario arithmetic on TEST estimates vs no email (N=12,802); b, c and m are assumed, not observed. The panels must NOT be added (double counting). Neither is observed revenue or profit.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: TEST has few matched purchases (see support table), so Panel B is imprecise.
